title: Service Concession Arrangements
summary: Addresses accounting for service concession arrangements where an operator provides public services on behalf of a grantor.
description: ASC 853 provides guidance for service concession arrangements — contracts where a private operator builds, upgrades, operates, or maintains public infrastructure on behalf of a government grantor. The operator does not recognise the infrastructure as PPE; instead, it recognises an intangible asset or receivable depending on the payment structure.

bannerNotice.title: Converged with IFRIC 12
bannerNotice.body: ASC 853 was added specifically to converge with IFRIC 12 (Service Concession Arrangements). Both frameworks use the same two-model approach (intangible asset vs receivable) and the same control indicators for scope, ensuring consistent accounting for PPP arrangements globally.
